components.label: River heat transport (reach temperatures on river surfaces)
components.method: Python river frames interpolated by the reader in both live and baked modes. Python owns transport and surface heat-budget integration.
components.notes: Frame-time temperatures and actual API probe equality pass headless checks; modeled temperatures remain unaccepted empirical predictions.

components.label: River flow (surface geometry and reach rate)
components.method: Published face discharge, depth and cell velocities are read from Python. Baked river surfaces retain authored geometry; flow shader speed scales with the published reach discharge.
components.notes: Geometry and shader speed are presentation inputs; runtime reader consistency does not validate hydraulic geometry.

components.label: Thermal and non-thermal pools (water surfaces)
components.method: Published pool-shell and pool-state temperatures set the thermal water shader. DataWatcher reloads changed pool data.
components.notes: Optional published state is consumed when present.

components.label: Pool pigment bands (microbial mat ramps)
components.method: Python pool ramps and mat pigment rasters provide shader inputs. Pigment republishes blend over three real seconds.
components.notes: Pigment is a visualization of the published model; no biological color validation is claimed.

components.label: Steam plumes above thermal pools
components.method: Published air, humidity and wind drive steam presentation. The steam microclimate sidecar adds pool-local moisture to the density visualization.
components.notes: Condensation visibility and the density multiplier are presentation calculations.

components.label: Wind gusts (foliage sway, steam advection)

components.label: Player walker and camera
